title: Terror!
description: The USS Cole is docked for refueling in Aden, Yemen, when two men in a small boat ram the warship at full speed; the resulting explosion kills 17 sailors Oct. 12, 2000.

title: Terror!
description: A suitcase left in the Bologna central station's lobby explodes, killing 85 people and injuring over 200.

title: Royals: Keeping the Crown
description: To survive to see the future, the royal family must reinvent themselves; they ditch their "stiff upper lip" approach to appear more normal, in order to stay relevant and in touch with their subjects.

title: Europe's Forgotten Border
description: Friends and relatives of the victims of the Czech border crossing search for the truth.

title: History: The Interesting Bits
description: A look at wars that lasted for centuries and others that were over in minutes, as well as the difficulty of ending a war; the possibility of starting a war over almost anything, from an unprovoked invasion to a lost ear, a pastry or a stolen bucket.

title: History: The Interesting Bits
description: A look at espionage; meeting spies from Delilah to Roald Dahl and along the way revealing the real model for James Bond.

title: The Lightbulb Moment
description: During WWII, Actress Hedy Lamarr, deemed the world's most beautiful woman, invented a technology that laid the groundwork for the wireless internet of today.

title: The Lightbulb Moment
description: The early days of online video were plagued by low resolution, stamp-sized video, and unbearable buffering times but that changed when a breakthrough technology revolutionized streaming video and set the foundation for the era of Netflix.

title: Deadly Roads
description: The Karakorum Highway, known as KKH, is a two thousand kilometer long trunk road linking Pakistan with China.

title: Deadly Roads
description: Showcases the Salang Tunnel, a major tunnel in Afghanistan that connects Kabul with the northern part of the country and Pakistan.

title: Growing Up
description: Altagan and Dsolbo travel across the desert of Mongolia to find precious green pastures to feed their entire camel herd during the winter.

title: Growing Up
description: Banda must climb giant trees to gather honey.

description: Wabak from Pentecost Island in Vanuatu has to jump from a wooden tower; his ankle is bound by thick vines.

title: Growing Up
description: In Siberia, Edik has to face wolves to protect his 4000 reindeer herd during the migration to the great north.

description: In 1856, a chemistry student accidentally created a strange substance with a rich purple hue; Mauve takes over the fashion industry, make food look more appetizing, and enable stunning advances in medicine.
